items.text: Tennessee (final): OUT - G Fernando Carmona Jr. (ankle); RB Tyjae Spears (knee) placed on IR Sat. QUESTIONABLE (all full Fri) - WR Carnell Tate (shoulder), LB Anthony Hill Jr. (neck), CB Micah Robinson (hip), S Tony Adams (concussion). RB Michael Carter elevated. IR - G Peter Skoronski, WR Wan'Dale Robinson. Cam Ward starts.

Dallas (final): OUT - CB DaRon Bland (ankle, to IR Sat), G Tyler Booker (ankle), TE Jake Ferguson (knee/ankle), S P.J. Locke (concussion), S Jalen Thompson (hamstring), CB Devin Moore (hip), WR Jonathan Mingo (ankle). QUESTIONABLE - TE Luke Schoonmaker (illness), LB Jaishawn Barham (hip/groin). Sat: RB Jashaun Corbin and CB Derion Kendrick elevated. Dak Prescott starts.
